donar.title: How to donate
donar.lede: Organizations and campaigns verified by this project. Each one carries a confidence level — verify for yourself before donating, especially for individual campaigns.

scamWarning.heading: Before you donate
scamWarning.point1: “SOS Chocó” is not a single organization — it's a slogan used by at least 5 different actors (Manos Visibles, Fundación Plan, FECOER, among others). Verify exactly which organization your donation goes to before trusting a link with that name.
scamWarning.point2: “Rescatistas LATAM” was investigated and no evidence was found that it exists as a real organization. Do not donate through channels using that name.
scamWarning.point3: Be wary of: links shared only via WhatsApp/SMS with no other trace, new and anonymous profiles, urgency pressure, and “exclusive victim lists”.

international.text: Donating from outside Colombia, or want to pay by debit/credit card? The local channels on this page require a Colombian bank account for some cases.

sections.individualNote: Individual fundraisers, not institutions — check the confidence level of each one before donating.
